note: Names lettered on the chart of the Midway map, for the eye only. The game reads none of it. kind: sea, water (a strait or sound), land (a large island or mainland), island, group. Positions are degrees, west negative as data/oob/place_positions.csv gives them (the page brings them into the map's run). Each is the position of its row of that file: Midway 5100, Kure 5106, Lisianski 5112, French Frigate Shoals 5110, Wake 5107. Pearl and Hermes Reef has no row and is not here; no sea is named, for none has a row.
